parse.title: Griffin
parse.text:
Overview

Griffin is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable from summon. When you obtain Griffin you will automatically be rewarded the Periapt of the King.

Evolving

Griffin can evolve into Griffin (Ascension) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Griffin
Result
Griffin
(Ascension)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7,500 Takedowns. [1]

Additionally, he requires at least 100% Ascension in the Periapt of the King to evolve.

About Ascension

When one uses the Periapt of the King in the Items section of their inventory, they will be teleported to a domain. By talking to the Griffin (Fallen) NPC, the player will be immediately given the choice between [Ascend] and [Sacrifice]. If [Sacrifice] is selected, the player will be offered a choice between sacrificing Periapts of Sacrifice, which raises Ascension by 0.5% each, or sacrificing Mythic units, giving 4.2% for unevolved units and 8.4% for evolved units. Any Mythics can be sacrificed, including Griffin and his evolved variant. If [Ascend] is selected the inventory will pop up, prompting the player to pick the Griffin they want to evolve, consuming 100% of the Ascension stored.

Do note that before sacrificing an eligible unit, one will be given a warning similar to that seen when sacrificing eligible units to the Sovereign's Staff.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
